source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: North Dakota Food and Culture: A Taste of World Cuisine, North Dakota State University Extension Service

steps.instruction: Chop 1 head of cabbage, 2 1/2 large carrots and 3 1/2 large tomatoes.
Chop 3 1/2 large potatoes, 2 medium onions, 2 cloves of garlic and 2 green peppers.
Put 2 1/4 pounds of beef stew meat in a large pot.
Add all the chopped vegetables to the pot.
Add salt and pepper to taste, if you like.
Add enough water to completely cover the mixture.
Add 1/2 tablespoon of vegetable oil and 1/2 tablespoon of vinegar.
Cover and cook on low heat for 2 hours, until everything is well done.
steps.spoken: Cook, covered, on low heat for two to three hours, until everything is well done.
